CorporateWellness

A one-stop corporate wellness program for business owners and HR teams. We come to your office with fitness training, yoga and massage therapy, on your schedule.

Book a free consultation →
Who it’s for
Business owners, HR and team leads
Where
Your office or workspace
Pricing
Varies by program and space. We’ll walk you through it
  1. 01

    Level One · Fitness

    A SOHO Fit trainer runs group fitness classes at your office, in an open space, a company gym or even your parking lot, at no cost to employees. Most companies hold them at the end of the day.

  2. 02

    Level Two · Fitness + Yoga

    Everything in Level One, plus a SOHO Fit yoga instructor in any semi-private space with a soft floor, usually early afternoon or end of day.

  3. 03

    Level Three · Fitness + Yoga + Massage

    Add a massage therapist who sets up a chair on site. Staff flow through for 15 to 30 minute massages, from a two-hour visit to a full working day.

Questions

Do I need a gym to have a corporate fitness program?

No, a gym is not required. You will need a suitable open space that is free of hazards where our trainers can setup basic equipment.

Are you insured?

Yes, absolutely we are. However, we also require that companies have employees sign their own individual liability waivers to participate.

What if I want to start small with one or two classes a week?

We can customize the program any way you like.

How much does a corporate program cost?

While we have a basic cost structure this will vary by the program you chose, times of day services are provided and your work space as some spaces take more time for setup and take down of equipment and items to provide the services. A Sohofit corporate sales representative would be happy to go through all of your options with you and provide you with pricing.
